name: cemetery_mausoleum_empty
source_description: A compact rectangular family mausoleum, six metres wide and seven deep, five metres tall. Dark charcoal ashlar with four restrained engaged facade pilasters, modest stone pediment, broad OPEN entrance and visibly EMPTY interior chamber. Genuine hollow structure with floor, walls and roof. Two narrow empty side window apertures. No glass, no doors, no coffin, no altar, no statue, no interior props. Dark weathered masonry and black slate cornice.
